open_questions: Comparative task success, cost and adoption have not been independently measured in this study; a controlled trial remains future work.
recommended_next_direction: Refresh affected official contracts and pinned snapshots before mutable comparisons; add studies only when a clear design question and evidence justify them.

output.audience: Curious technical readers, builders and authors learning agent mechanisms and implementation choices.

validation.method: npm run validate: 48 deployment tests, 135 content tests, Astro check 0 errors/warnings/hints, 84-page build and docs lint.

rendering.method: Chromium: all 15 pages at 1440/light+dark, 390/light and 320/dark, reduced motion; keyboard/nav/focus/panning/citation/full-size image checks; representative manual screenshot review; search and discovery.

exports.method: 30 Markdown/MDX endpoint checks; all footnotes, numbered captions and anchors retained; native diagram/card text exported, no raw presentation JSON; math regression checks pass.
